finding: A missing /dev/fd directory is not a closed stdout. Treating it as one silenced every autopilot failure. After the probe can see the descriptor, uid 0 is a second pure gate: the suite stops, heat is zero, orientation is fail.
mitigation: Probe /dev/fd only when that directory exists; otherwise use /proc/self/fd. If neither exists, do not redirect a live descriptor to /dev/null.
